Retention.title: Data retention
Retention.subtitle: What the platform keeps, what it destroys, and what is stopping it
Retention.storageNotConfiguredNote: Documents are not destroyed: the platform cannot confirm that a file was actually deleted, and a purge record with no confirmation is a false record.
Retention.legalHoldTitle: No retention window chosen for documents
Retention.legalHoldBody: This is LEGAL-004. While the question stays open, the platform does not assign a window on its own: a document's window field is empty, and an empty window means "cannot be destroyed". Answering the question is one policy entry, not a code change.
Retention.runRestrictedToAdmin: Running the job is available to administrators.
Retention.documentsEmpty: No document has been uploaded — collection is disabled pending an answer on LEGAL-004, so there is nothing to destroy yet.
Retention.stuckBody: Destruction started and was not confirmed. The job will retry on its own; if a row stays here for a long time, storage is unreachable.
Retention.holdsBody: A hold blocks destruction and opens nothing. Support and moderation can place one; only an administrator can lift one, and must name a reason.
Retention.runsEmpty: The job has not run yet.
Retention.catalogueBody1: This is the same declaration the retention service reads — it cannot describe a policy the code does not have. A test checks it against the database schema: a table cannot be added without saying what happens to its data.
Retention.catalogueBody2: Open legal questions the windows depend on: {deps}.
Retention.placeHoldFormNote: A hold stops the background job from destroying this data. It deletes nothing and opens nothing.
Retention.placeHoldExplanationLabel: Explanation — read by whoever lifts the hold
Retention.releaseHoldFormNote: Lifting it allows this data to be destroyed again. The reason is kept in the log.
Retention.releaseHoldReasonLabel: Why the hold is no longer needed
Retention.runNoteStorageMissing: Document storage isn't configured, so no documents will be destroyed. The job will only remove expired sessions, one-time tokens, and internal counters.
